description: External queue, for manual or agent use: submit translations for a claimed job (POST /mt/jobs/{id}). Every unit needs its source `hash` exactly as lang_list_pending returned it, so a changed source is answered stale_source instead of overwritten. Returns { job, state, units } with a status per unit (written, rejected, stale_source, manual, changed, unknown, forbidden); state `lost` with code cvrt_lang_mt_lease means the lease is gone (nothing more to do for this job); 409 cvrt_lang_mt_busy means submit the same units again.

token.description: Lease token of the claimed job: the `lease` value lang_list_pending returned for it (64 hex characters)

hash.description: The unit's source hash exactly as claimed

name: lang_submit_translations
